reasons.action: The brief states an explicit behaviour — the car pulling forward out of the dark — so the requested action governs over any static pose in the storyboard plate.
reasons.medium: No supplied reference carries authority over the rendering medium, so the rendering process stays request-governed.
reasons.wardrobe: Nothing in the request names clothing or accessories, and the storyboard is not a wardrobe reference, so wardrobe remains request-governed.
reasons.lighting: "Out of the dark" is an instruction about the light the car emerges from — the presence and quality of darkness around it — so lighting is request-governed rather than taken from the storyboard.
reasons.framing: The request contains no camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or camera movement of its own (the car simply being in motion is not a framing instruction), so the supplied storyboard reference retains framing authority as permitted.
reasons.palette: The stated emergence from darkness implies a tonal, dark-to-visible grading treatment, so palette is governed by the request rather than the reference.
